Ceilings, live parts only, D30 dynamic derivation. The tool measures base at execution during this bundle's retirement pass, after the initial eligible moves, and persists ceiling = base + headroom. Bases are never transcribed here. Live findings: base = line count of findings.md at that moment; headroom = 7 times the median line-count of a live finding entry at that moment. Live rulings: base = line count of rulings.md at that moment; headroom = 2 times the median line-count of a live H2 decision entry at that moment. Live registry: base = live row count at that moment; headroom = 15 additional live-row slots (a policy constant, not a measurement of decisions.md). Citation index: base = line count of decisions.md after the split; headroom = 40 lines (ten stubs of four lines; a policy constant). Failure text names retire / move to the retired sibling, never a config key, and says raising the persisted ceiling is not the remedy.
